before: Compose passed over a file's move range only when nothing was drawn between its markers. Once a folded move's words all went (the source by a direct deletion, the copy taken back) and a decision showed a control's prompt again in their place, the room wrote the range markers around the prompt; after a fold, the move was gone and the same decision wrote none.
after: Compose passes over a file's move range with no moved word drawn in it, as the room draws no range around no words, so a decision gives the same file live and after a fold.
reason: Change messages, the change log and the Yjs document format do not change. The checkpoint manifest and its version 5 stay. Only how compose writes a move range that holds no moved word changes; every copy composes with the same code version, so the copies agree. Ordered rooms are not deployed yet, so no room needs a migration.
